moon: expected very large price increase bullish
to the moon: expected very large price increase bullish
mooning: experiencing very large price increase bullish
FOMO: fear of missing out bullish buying pressure
short squeeze: forced buying pressure rapid upward price movement
paper hands: weak holder sold early bearish conviction
diamond hands: strong holder long term conviction bullish
theta gang: options premium seller neutral to bearish
bull trap: false bullish signal followed by decline
bear trap: false bearish signal followed by rise
dead cat bounce: temporary price recovery before continued decline bearish
buy the dip: purchase on temporary price decline bullish
resistance: price level where selling pressure increases
support: price level where buying interest increases
oversold: declining too rapidly likely reversal bullish
overbought: rising too rapidly likely pullback bearish
squeeze: rapid price movement forced by options or short covering
melt up: gradual but sustained price increase bullish
